review the MultiPassEmissionAbsorptionRenderer class and its emission-absorption ray marching equations

review the RayPointRefiner configurable options for random sampling, adding input samples, and blurpool weight settings
create an AdaptiveRaySampler that adaptively samples points on rays based on scene center and extent

compute radii of conical frustums in world coordinates from camera and xy grid inputs

run the sphere tracing algorithm from both ends of a ray to find surface intersections

run the sphere intersection calculation to find where rays enter and exit a bounding sphere

forward feature vectors, points, normals, and a ray bundle through the coloring network
configure the network with harmonic embedding functions for view direction encoding
switch the network rendering mode between idr, no_view_dir, or no_normal
enable or disable weight normalization on the network linear layers

refactor the _sample_network function to compute differentiable surface points from SDF gradients and ray directions
summarize the _gradient function which computes differentiable gradients of an implicit SDF module via autograd
